dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical linear narrowing from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle region.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey median pixel intensity across the dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Diffuse, low-frequency pixel variance with no distinct dark mottling clusters visible.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradients between primary light-grey tones and secondary shading along the body periphery.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Segmented, high-contrast white linear marks oriented longitudinally along the central dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple longitudinal linear scars/marks concentrated on the dorsal midline.
